newsitem.title: USA: Excel says in pact to buy wireless minutes.
newsitem.headline: Excel says in pact to buy wireless minutes.

text.p: Excel Communications said Wednesday it had signed a letter of intent with NextWave Telecom Inc to negotiate the purchase of wireless minutes on Nextwave's nationwide Personal Communications Service (PCS) network.
Excel said that the pact was in keeping with its strategy to introduce new products and services through its marketing network of independent representatives.

Excel chief executive Kenny Troutt also said in a release, "In addition to PCS, EXCEL is building the infrastructure to maintain its competitive edge and is evaluating entering the local service, DBS, and Internet service markets in the future."
The company said the pact would provide for the purchase of airtime on a wholesale basis.

Excel Communications is the fifth largest long distance company in the United States in terms of presubscribed lines, according to the Federal Communications Commission. Its services are marketed through a national network of independent representatives.
NextWave Telecom is a Personal Communications Service provider with the third largest wireless franchise in the United States.
